title: Built FindRedDrop – A MERN Stack Blood Donation Platform
description: Developed FindRedDrop as a full-stack web application to gain practical experience with the MERN stack. Implemented role-based access control for Admin, Donor, and Volunteer; secure authentication using JWT and BetterAuth; Stripe payment integration; server-side pagination; image upload and storage using ImgBB; and MongoDB database integration.

title: IEEE Student Branch KUET – A Journey of Creativity and Leadership
description: Shared my journey and experiences with IEEE Student Branch KUET, contributing to creative strategies, branding, visual content, and the organization of technical workshops, seminars, and events.

title: 8th Place – 6th Kibo Robot Programming Challenge
description: Our team, Nam Lagbe Na, secured 8th place in the 6th Kibo Robot Programming Challenge Preliminary Round in Bangladesh. Despite having no prior real-world programming experience, we collaborated to develop autonomous navigation and image recognition solutions for NASA's ISS Astrobee robot. The experience taught me the importance of persistence, teamwork, and collaborative problem-solving.

title: Appointed Assistant Operations Secretary – KBEC
description: Started a new leadership journey as Assistant Operations Secretary at KUET Business and Entrepreneurship Club, taking on responsibilities in event management, organizational operations, communication, and team coordination.

title: Developed iConnect – A JavaFX Desktop Application
description: Developed iConnect as part of my Advanced Programming Laboratory course project during the 4th semester. Built a desktop application featuring user authentication, a personalized dashboard, notes management, and a real-time chat system using JavaFX, CSS, MySQL, API parsing, and polling techniques.

title: Graduate – Aspire Leaders Program 2024
description: Successfully completed the Aspire Leaders Program 2024, hosted by Aspire Institute, an initiative founded at Harvard Business School Online. The program focused on leadership development, professional growth, social impact, and essential interpersonal skills.

title: Joined Team Durbar – Autonomous Sub-team
description: Selected as a trainee member of the Autonomous Sub-team of Team Durbar, a community of passionate young engineers working on rover challenges. Began exploring autonomous systems, robotics, and collaborative engineering.

title: Built a Vehicle Detection System Using OpenCV
description: Explored image processing and computer vision by developing a vehicle detection system using Python and OpenCV after two weeks of self-learning. Implemented motion-based vehicle detection and counting without relying on a pre-trained model, with automated data storage in CSV format for further analysis.

title: Recognized for Volunteering at Hult Prize KUET
description: Received a certificate of appreciation from the Vice-Chancellor of Khulna University of Engineering & Technology in recognition of my contributions as a volunteer for Hult Prize at KUET.

title: Started My Journey with KUET Business and Entrepreneurship Club
description: Began my journey with KUET Business and Entrepreneurship Club, gaining opportunities to collaborate, learn, and contribute to student-led initiatives and organizational activities.

title: Selected as a Volunteer – Hult Prize at KUET 2023–24
description: Selected as a volunteer for Hult Prize at KUET 2023–24, the world's largest student social entrepreneurship competition. Participated in planning, event operations, collaboration, and initiatives focused on economic empowerment and social entrepreneurship.

title: 2nd Runner-Up – BizBash 3.0 Business Case Study Competition
description: Our team, The Catalysts, secured 2nd Runner-Up position in BizBash 3.0, organized by KUET Career Club. Collaborated to analyze complex business challenges, develop strategic solutions, and present our ideas through teamwork and creative problem-solving.
